parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for shard_id, num_shards, init_method, cfg_file, and opts
load_config_from_args: load and initialize configs from a YAML file and command line opts into a cfg object
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get an argparse namespace with shard and config file settings
test_load_config: test load_config by passing parsed args and verifying cfg merges from file and opts
review_parse_args_load_config: review parse_args and load_config to understand the MemVIT argument parsing and config loading pipeline
